💲 Adjusted EBITA: $3.5B vs $2B expected
💸 Q2 capex: $18.37B vs $18.5B expected

Starlink reached 12 million subscribers at the end of Q2.

Polymarket is in early talks with investors to raise an additional $1 billion at a $20 billion valuation, according to reports. 

If it closes the funding round, Polymarket will be worth more than twice as much as it was in October 2025, when it raised money at a valuation of $9 billion.

Japan and the US jolted the yen out of a historic slide.

📉 Japanese exporters took the hit, but the shock has not spread far.

📈 US and global stocks are still pressing toward records.

⚠️ The yen and long bonds bear watching — but for now, markets are treating this as a currency event, not a broader break.

Jeff Bezos is selling $4 billion in Amazon stock, nearly 15 million shares, an SEC filing revealed.

Bezos originally acquired the shares in 1994  as "Founder Stock."

The move to sell follows Amazon's recent spike, soaring nearly 20% over the last 5 trading days.

Former OpenAI employee Leopold Aschenbrenner "did pile on a lot of leverage," WSJ's Gregory Zuckerman says.

"But it wasn't just leverage ... You could pile on a leverage if the underlying investments aren't volatile. But if you're going to long, short AI-related stocks, it's sort of inevitable that at some point you're going to have some setbacks that's gonna to lead to a margin call, that's going to lead to panic," @GZuckerman explains.
